definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being sweet. Used especially when discussing food and drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘|あま}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This apple has a strong sweetness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧{甘|あま}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Add sugar to bring out the sweetness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な{甘|あま}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: When you simmer vegetables, a natural sweetness comes out.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧ (sweet) → {甘|あま}み (sweetness). The suffix み converts adjectives into nouns indicating the quality or degree.

WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{甘味|あまみ}→甘味：07017_amami⟧. Note that ⟦{甘味|かんみ}→甘味：13571_kanmi⟧ (read かんみ) means "sweets" or "dessert" — a different word.

SIMILAR PATTERN:
- {甘|あま}み (sweetness), {辛|から}み (spiciness), {苦|にが}み (bitterness), {酸|す}み (sourness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甘|あま}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have sweetness
- {甘|あま}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: strongly sweet
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な{甘|あま}み: natural sweetness
- {甘|あま}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧: to bring out the sweetness
